d: Deep plum hair is styled into two thick braided pigtails with straight-cut bangs. Round, wide-eyed eyes of a pale lavender hue are visible behind oversized, white-rimmed circular glasses. The face is youthful and adolescent, paired with a slender build. The outfit is a scholarly uniform consisting of a white collared shirt with a red tie, a dark purple blazer with gold trim, a matching dark purple pleated mini-skirt, white stockings with gold bands, and white shoes. Accessories include white gloves, a lime-green sash tied at the waist that flows behind, and a large blue and gold magical book held in one hand.
